notes.title: Shot Shot Tactic - New Game on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi, our new game Shot shot Tactic is on Greelight now.

Shot Shot Tactic is a multiplayer First Person Shooter Game. 
Now include 3 maps as WesternDesert, Restaurant and Basic Map.
Game Modes : Team Death Match - Free For All - Bomb Defuse - Conquest 
Game will support steam trading carts, emotions and steam inventory. 
There are customizable characters' cloths and customizable weapons. 
Game is ready to publish on steam. 

Vote for Shot Shot Tactic

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=793134889

notes.title: Second Day in Head Shot
notes.content:
Hı Players,

We released game 36 hours ago, we got some bug reports and we are working on fixing them.

We are happy to announce that we will add Polish language support tonight.

Steam Cards become activated after 2 hours of playing and then you can get 1 card per 20 minutes. Maybe this time will increase because steam gives card but we set time to 20 minutes. Craft your badge and get emoticons and profile backgrounds.

We will create event "Play With Dev Team" in this Week so tell your friends and be ready for the battle.

Don't forget that game is in early development stage and we still working on making it much better.

Thanks for your support and patience.

Feel FREE to contact us to report bugs and give us you're advices.

At the end It is your game ...

notes.title: First 12 Hours Report
notes.content:
Dear Players,

We are happy to release the Game. We know there are some bugs. We started to working on this issues. 

We know there is some player problem which mean there is not too many players, but Head Shot is a multiplayer fps game, so we need Online players. Call your friends please...

We will be happy if you review fairly and don't forget to game is in development.

Thanks for patience ...
